subject.title: Control UI: preview GitHub issues and pull requests on hover

question: Should GitHub issue and pull request hover previews be a built-in Control UI/Gateway feature, or should this remain outside core until a maintainer sponsors the UI/API surface?
rationale: The request is a new user-facing Control UI interaction and likely stable Gateway API surface, not a broken existing behavior with an established contract.

options.title: Sponsor core implementation
options.body: Build the bounded Gateway metadata method and Control UI card because it fits web-frontend ergonomics and maintainer-review workflows.

options.title: Defer from core
options.body: Keep current link navigation unless an existing plugin/extension point can provide previews without new Gateway protocol surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor core implementation
recommendation.body: Build the bounded Gateway metadata method and Control UI card because it fits web-frontend ergonomics and maintainer-review workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows Peter as the strongest owner signal for the Markdown renderer, chat hover/context work, and Gateway registry surface implicated by this feature.
